gapcov_routes.policy: Node IDs reference installed dependency data; no dependency geometry is redistributed. Consecutive IDs have reciprocal adjacency; no loop closing edge is implied. Reverse the chain for return. Nearest road is a candidate only, never evidence of an anchor approach, island-local road, navmesh, driving or water access. Never bridge disconnected components, interpolate a shortcut, teleport, alter native movement or infer native qualification.
gapcov_routes.runtime_integration: Catalog is authoring data, not consumed by current DTOs. Page into existing bounded owners only after source-pin resolution, actual site/party binding and native path qualification. Keep current Routes lists intact. Derive operational status from HCGetOperationalStatus/HCPublish; loaded catalog alone cannot establish readiness.

gapcov_survey_receipt_contract.evidence_policy: Private receipt, exact-source hashes and server log. UTC ISO timestamp, unique run identity, both directions recorded separately. Two distinct client identities required for visibility/custody checks. Boat mode requires actual depth/grounding/landing observations; walking never accepts driving/boat/shelter access. Any pending/refused check prevents passed verdict. Native survey does not bypass live per-segment geometry, perception, observer veto, physical custody or bounded owners. No receipt is shipped or fabricated by the offline generator.
